introduction: Specification 10 rewrites the Anthropic provider wire on the official anthropic-sdk-go SDK, introduces unified environment resolution across Direct, Vertex AI, and AWS Bedrock, streamlines the model catalog to Claude lookups with safe fallbacks, establishes discrete adaptive thinking effort controls and strict tool definitions, and enforces wire stability through golden request assertions.

glossary.adaptive_thinking: Claude reasoning mode where the model dynamically adjusts thinking token allocation based on a discrete Effort level instead of a fixed budget_tokens integer.
glossary.effort: Discrete reasoning effort levels (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) passed in output_config to guide adaptive thinking models.
glossary.ephemeral_cache_control: Anthropic prompt cache breakpoint annotation (cache_control: {type: ephemeral}) placed at strategic request positions to enable prompt prefix caching.
glossary.strict_tool: Anthropic tool definition serialized with strict: true guaranteeing strict JSON schema compliance by the model.

requirements.title: Dependency Integration and Allowlist Policy
requirements.rationale: Replacing hand-rolled transport and parsing with the official Anthropic SDK eliminates custom protocol maintenance while enforcing dependency allowlist constraints.

criteria.action: require github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go pinned in go.mod

criteria.condition: the dependency allowlist test in internal/policy/deps_test.go evaluates direct dependencies from go.mod
criteria.action: approve github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go as an authorized direct dependency
use official SDK client primitives from github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go for HTTP transport and stream decoding, eliminating custom SSE parsing and ad-hoc credential refresh routines

requirements.title: Multi-Deployment Environment Resolution
requirements.rationale: Unified environment resolution allows switching seamlessly between Direct Anthropic, GCP Vertex AI, and AWS Bedrock deployments using ambient credentials and explicit flags.

criteria.action: expose Resolve(env Env) (*anthropic.Client, Source, error) where Env allows injecting variable lookups and override maps without modifying process-level environment variables
define Source as a typed string with values SourceDirect, SourceVertex, and SourceBedrock

criteria.condition: env evaluates CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX as truthy ("1" or "true")
criteria.guard: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX is not an explicit off flag ("0" or "false")
criteria.action: construct an *anthropic.Client configured for Google Cloud Vertex AI using ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID (or GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT), CLOUD_ML_REGION (defaulting to "global"), and custom proxy URL ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL if set, and return SourceVertex

criteria.condition: env evaluates CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK as truthy ("1" or "true")
criteria.guard: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK is not an explicit off flag ("0" or "false")
criteria.action: construct an *anthropic.Client configured for AWS Bedrock and return SourceBedrock

criteria.condition: neither Vertex nor Bedrock is enabled
criteria.guard: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN is present in env
criteria.action: construct a direct Anthropic client configured with the key or token and optional ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, and return SourceDirect

criteria.condition: neither Vertex nor Bedrock is enabled and neither ANTHROPIC_API_KEY nor ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN is present in env
criteria.action: reject the resolution and return an error explaining that credentials are missing
criteria.contract: non-nil error stating missing credentials and nil client pointer

criteria.condition: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX or CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK is explicitly set to "0" or "false"
criteria.guard: secondary cloud project coordinates exist in env
criteria.action: disable the specified cloud deployment and fall through to direct resolution
verify Direct, Vertex, and Bedrock client configurations and base URLs offline without initiating network requests

requirements.title: Claude Model Catalog and Lookup
requirements.rationale: Simplifying the catalog to Claude model lookups eliminates dead multi-vendor code while providing safe fallback descriptors for newly released models.

criteria.action: remove all non-Claude vendor sections (OpenAI, Google) from catalog/catalog.json and retain only Claude model descriptors
remove catalog/resolve.go and catalog/clamp.go

criteria.condition: catalog.Lookup(id string) is called with a known Claude model ID, with or without an "anthropic/" prefix
criteria.action: return the corresponding core.Model descriptor and boolean true

criteria.condition: catalog.Lookup(id string) is called with an uncataloged model ID
criteria.action: return a default core.Model descriptor with ID set to the queried string, context window of 1,000,000 tokens, output cap of 128,000 tokens, ThinkingKindAdaptive, zero cost, and boolean false
for any model ID queried against catalog.Lookup, return a usable model descriptor without rejecting the query with an error
isolate all model pricing rates, token limits, and thinking capabilities exclusively within catalog without hardcoding model identifiers or rates in provider/anthropic

requirements.title: Adaptive Thinking and Effort Controls
requirements.rationale: Modern Claude models require adaptive thinking with discrete effort levels and reject legacy budget tokens with 400 Bad Request errors.

criteria.action: define the Effort type with discrete levels EffortLow ("low"), EffortMedium ("medium"), EffortHigh ("high"), EffortXHigh ("xhigh"), and EffortMax ("max")

criteria.condition: encoding a request for a model configured with adaptive thinking
criteria.action: emit "thinking": {"type": "adaptive"} and "output_config": {"effort": "<level>"} and omit budget_tokens

criteria.condition: encoding a request for a model configured with legacy budget thinking
criteria.action: emit budget_tokens and omit output_config.effort

criteria.condition: a model's catalog metadata does not support reasoning effort
criteria.action: omit the thinking parameter without mutating or clamping the request to off

requirements.title: Strict Tool Serialization and Schema Projection
requirements.rationale: Emitting strict: true guarantees adherence to schema definitions, while stripping internal tool metadata and forbidding forced tool choices prevents wire rejections.

criteria.condition: emitting tool definitions on the Anthropic wire
criteria.action: set "strict": true on every tool declaration
strip internal tool fields OutputSchema, ReachableTools, and Terminating from wire tool definitions

criteria.condition: emitting tool choice options on the Anthropic wire
criteria.action: omit forced tool choice ("any" or a named tool lock) and set tool_choice to "auto" or omit the field

requirements.title: Argument Byte Preservation and Prompt Cache Breakpoints
requirements.rationale: Preserving argument JSON bytes and establishing fixed prompt cache breakpoints maximizes prompt cache hit rates across iterative agent turns.

criteria.condition: replaying assistant tool_use argument inputs across multi-turn requests
criteria.action: preserve the exact raw bytes received from the model (json.RawMessage) without re-serializing or reformatting JSON keys

criteria.condition: constructing request payloads with a system prompt
criteria.action: apply ephemeral cache control ("cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}) to the final content block of the system prompt

criteria.condition: constructing request payloads with tool definitions
criteria.action: apply ephemeral cache control ("cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}) to the final tool definition in the tools list

criteria.condition: prefix messages are provided in the conversation history
criteria.action: apply ephemeral cache control ("cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}) to the final content block of the prefix messages

criteria.condition: constructing request payloads with user message history
criteria.action: apply ephemeral cache control ("cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}) to the final content block of the user message history

requirements.title: Response and Stream Translation
requirements.rationale: Translating official SDK responses into AgentKit core types ensures seamless integration with transcript history and accurate token cost accounting.

criteria.condition: receiving responses or streaming events from the Anthropic SDK
criteria.action: translate SDK message payloads into core.AssistantMessage with content blocks including TextBlock, ThinkingBlock, and ToolUseBlock

criteria.condition: translating streaming events or message deltas from the Anthropic SDK
criteria.action: record token consumption in core.Usage, tracking input tokens, output tokens, cache read tokens, cache creation tokens, and increment request counts
forward stream events to the agent event stream without blocking the provider loop when consumers process slowly

requirements.title: Wire Golden Request Verification
requirements.rationale: Golden request tests pin serialization invariants and guard against accidental drift across SDK updates.

criteria.condition: running golden_requests_test.go against testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json
criteria.action: assert the complete wire request produced by the SDK encoder matches the golden request fixture
assert that cache_control appears exactly on the last system block, last tool definition, last prefix block, and last user block
assert that every tool carries "strict": true and that no OutputSchema, ReachableTools, or Terminating fields appear in the payload
assert that modern models emit "thinking": {"type": "adaptive"} and "output_config": {"effort": "<level>"} without budget_tokens
assert that replayed tool_use arguments match the input fixture byte-for-byte

execution_paths.title: Offline environment resolution for Claude on Google Cloud Vertex AI

steps.action: injects environment variables CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1, ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID=test-project, and CLOUD_ML_REGION=us-central1 via Env
evaluates anthropic.Resolve(env) and identifies Vertex AI deployment configuration
constructs an *anthropic.Client configured with Vertex Google authentication and regional base URL
inspects the resolved client and asserts SourceVertex without making external network calls

execution_paths.title: Wire request encoding with strict tools, adaptive thinking, and prompt caching

steps.action: prepares a canonical request with system prompt, user history, a tool definition, and EffortHigh
evaluates catalog.Lookup to obtain model metadata confirming adaptive thinking capabilities
builds the Anthropic Messages wire request adding strict: true, ephemeral cache control breakpoints, and adaptive thinking effort
verifies the serialized request matches testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json byte-for-byte

execution_paths.title: Multi-turn assistant tool use replay with raw byte preservation

steps.action: streams an assistant message containing a tool_use block with formatted JSON input
extracts the raw JSON argument bytes into core.AssistantMessage without deserialization
submits the conversation history containing the assistant message to anthropic.BuildRequest for the next turn
serializes the replayed tool_use block retaining the exact original JSON bytes on the wire
